question_text: Describe how you check if a device is powered on.
expected_answer: You inspect the power light check the switch and verify the outlet works

question_text: Explain how you test basic connectivity.
expected_answer: You check the network icon run a simple ping and confirm the device has an IP address

question_text: Describe how you verify that an application is responding.
expected_answer: You click the window check task manager and restart the app if needed

question_text: Explain how you check whether a cable is connected.
expected_answer: You inspect both ends verify link lights and reseat the connector

question_text: Describe how you test if a user account is working.
expected_answer: You attempt login check credentials and confirm the account is active

question_text: Explain how you check whether a printer is online.
expected_answer: You inspect the display check network status and restart the printer

question_text: Describe how you verify that WiFi is enabled.
expected_answer: You check the WiFi icon open settings and confirm the adapter is on

question_text: Explain how you test basic audio output.
expected_answer: You check volume settings test with a known sound and verify the device is selected

question_text: Describe how you check if a website is reachable.
expected_answer: You open the site test another site and check network status

question_text: Explain how you verify that a device has internet access.
expected_answer: You run a ping test open a webpage and confirm DNS resolution
